items.rationale: Writing pen, eraser and ruler are familiar school stationery in the selected senses; a cup is a drinking vessel. A cup being usable at school does not make it stationery. The exact group is broad enough to include drawing and erasing without falsely calling all three ink-writing instruments. No hidden-definition dependency or plausible equally strong intruder exists among these four.

Frying pan, cooking pot and serving bowl are all vessels that contain food; the knife cuts food and is not a vessel. The common kitchen setting gives a meaningful thematic contrast, and the label correctly avoids claiming the serving bowl must be heated. Checked dictionary definitions match the exact KG identities.

Truck, minibus and van are road motor vehicles in their displayed everyday senses; the train travels by rail. Cargo versus passengers would not separate the intended group because each can carry either in some configuration. The exact road predicate supplies the honest distinction. Historical alternate senses of dubă do not displace the selected common vehicle sense.

Predicate mismatch: Aeroport is the airfield/buildings/facilities complex, whereas terminal denotes a passenger departure/arrival location within an airport. The label Terminal și vehicul aerian falsely identifies the airport as a terminal. Pair itself is familiar; the label must be corrected and separately reviewed.

Tooth/toothbrush, mop/floor, tree/root and shopping/shop are factual anatomy-use, cleaning-use, part-whole and activity-location associations. The word root can also describe part of a tooth, but taking that association leaves no equally defensible complete partition for tree and toothbrush. Shop is one ordinary place for purchases; the label does not exclude markets or online shopping. All selected senses are familiar and exact.

Predicate mismatch: exact n_v4sti_floare is Organ al plantei implicat în reproducere. Plantă ornamentală și recipient pentru cultivare calls that organ an entire plant. The everyday pot association is plausible but this exact label is dishonest; use an explicit flower-to-its-plant-container association, then bind a new review.

scope: Complete factual review of exact original six-board bytes. Two boards rejected because hidden predicate labels contradict exact identity meaning. Four unchanged boards accepted. This original rejection is retained even after separately reviewed corrections.
